{{Quote|Betty's my custom JG-1 landspeeder. I named her after Darth Betton, this really gorgeous&mdash;|Tyrak|<ref name="TOR" />}}
The '''JG-1 landspeeder''' was a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] model. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] owned a JG-1 landspeeder which he named "[[Betty (landspeeder)|Betty]]" after [[Darth Betton]].<ref name="TOR" />
